_source: read back over JSON-RPC after restarting Kodi from config/kodi/guisettings-appliance.xml, so every value below is what the repo profile produces on a cold start, not a runtime edit

_enabled_because.ac3passthrough: ELD SAD2 declares AC-3 6ch/640k; low-level IEC61937 and Kodi passthrough both verified audible at the sink
_enabled_because.eac3passthrough: ELD SAD4 declares E-AC-3 8ch; Kodi passthrough verified audible; it is also the canonical asset's native codec, so this keeps that title bit-exact

_disabled_because.dtspassthrough: ELD SAD3 declares DTS 6ch/1504k, but the sink reproduces nothing from it. Kodi's side was correct (RAW sink opened, AES0=0x06, zero errors) - the sink is the limit.
_disabled_because.truehdpassthrough: no MLP/TrueHD SAD in the ELD
_disabled_because.dtshdpassthrough: no DTS-HD SAD in the ELD
_disabled_because.ac3transcode: both transcode targets produced silence at this sink despite a clean machine-side stream; leaving it off keeps a DTS title on the working 2.0 PCM path
_disabled_because.channels=2.0: ELD SAD1 declares LPCM 6ch but the sink reproduces nothing from 6-channel LPCM either
